highlights: Earn up to 10 points per dollar on overseas retail, dining, and travel, and 5 points per dollar on dining transactions in SGD. You can earn up to 10,360° Reward Points on overseas retail transactions, with a base rate of 1 point per dollar on all other spending. Capped at 20,000 points per year
pros: Up to 10X reward points for every S$1 spent in foreign currency on overseas retail, dining and travel transactions.
pros: Up to 5X reward points for every S$1 spent on dining transactions.
pros: 1 reward point for every S$1 spent on all eligible spend.

pros: SC Shop and Earn - Upgrade your home and earn up to 8.05% Cashback. Shop top home and electronics brands like Dyson, Heavenluxe, Samsung, Xiaomi and many more. Unlock one of the highest Cashback as a Priority client. Log on to SC Shop and Earn via SC Mobile to start shopping.
pros: No min. spend required, 1 year annual fee waiver.
pros: Complimentary travel insurance coverage of up to S$500,000 when you charge your full travel fare to the card.
pros: Read our full review of the Standard Chartered Rewards+ Credit Card.
cons: Additional reward points are capped at 20,000 points per year.
cons: Purchases from local hotel restaurants and supermarkets are not considered as qualifying dining transactions.

extra.description: The Standard Chartered Rewards+ Credit Card is made for travellers — offering up to 10 bonus points on select overseas spend, with no minimum spend required. At the same time, you'll be spoilt for choice with the highly attractive reedeemable rewards.
